summary: Data Analyst alternate pose source image for the Issue #56 stakeholder pack. The image shows a full-body isolated Data Analyst figure on a plain white background, in a relaxed standing or three-quarter view that varies from the hero pose through a different hand gesture or prop arrangement. She is a warm, organized young woman with brown skin, large round glasses, brown curly hair in a loose high bun with stray curls, gold hoop earrings, a small necklace, a cream oversized cardigan over a white top, high-waisted brown trousers with rolled cuffs, mustard socks, and cream sneakers. A purple lanyard badge with a lightbulb-style insight icon is visible, along with analytics props such as a calendar grid, filter funnel, check marks, and purple-and-gold charts or reports. The rendering is the clean vector-adjacent Adventures editorial style with soft painterly shading, warm light, and a calm, helpful expression.
